hxdatetime.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains functions to support retrieving locale specific strftime formatting strings with some control over simple formatting requirements for the locale.

Function Documentation

HxResult HxDateTimeString ( nl_item  item,
HxDateTimeFormat  modifier,
char *  pLocaleString,
int *  pStringLength 
)

Return a strftime format string.

This function should return a string which can be passed to strftime. The string should be the formatting string from the locale file modified by the available HxDateTimeFormat_t modifiers.

Parameters:
item IN: the nl item to be used valid value include: D_T_FMT D_FMT T_FMT
modifier IN: The modification flags to be used. These can be used in combination like a bitmask. If you do not use SHOW_SECONDS or HIDE_SECONDS that implies that the specification in the locale file will be honored. The same applies to year.
pLocaleString OUT: Returns a string which is preallocated and only valid until a subsequent call to this function. If NULL, only pStringLength is modified.
pStringLength IN/OUT: The input value of *pStringLength represents the size of the pLocaleString buffer. If *pStringLength is less than the required buffer,. *pStringLength is set to the required size, and HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL is returned.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
